title: Act CVIII of 2023 on the rules of corporate social responsibility serving sustainable finance and uniform corporate responsibility, and amending related acts (ESG Act, 2023. évi CVIII. törvény)
citation: 2023. évi CVIII. törvény (adopted 2023-12-12, promulgated 2023-12-22, Magyar Közlöny 2023. évi 187. szám)
evidence: 53. § (1): "Ez a törvény – a (2)–(5) bekezdésben meghatározott kivétellel – 2024. január 1-jén lép hatályba." Opened https://magyarkozlony.hu/hivatalos-lapok/4kRl30n61EB7V7OcUh7M65820c6443b5b/dokumentumok/b5e0520aee1a0db8631efa32546c55a00fd6037c/letoltes (Magyar Közlöny issue PDF, Magyar Közlöny 2023. évi 187. szám) on 2026-11-02. Promulgation 2023-12-22 from the NJT footnote "A kihirdetés napja: 2023. december 22." (https://njt.jog.gov.hu/jogszabaly/2023-108-00-00) and the issue date on https://magyarkozlony.hu/.
notes: ESG reporting (ESG beszámoló, s. 23) and the sustainability due diligence duty (s. 17) sit in the same act; the register row said F5, this entry is F1 as the brief directs and the due diligence order is its own F5 entry (hu-esg-sztfh-13-2024). Sections 60 to 63 insert Chapter III/A (sustainability report, ss. 95/D to 95/I) and Chapter VI/C into the Accounting Act (see hu-accounting-act-2000-c). Other dates: ss. 45 and 46 on 2024-01-07, s. 102 on 2024-07-01, ss. 72 and 76(1) on 2025-01-01, s. 26(2) on 2026-01-01. The full title on the official page differs from the brief (which ended "vállalatirányítási (ESG) szabályokról"): it ends "vállalati társadalmi felelősségvállalás szabályairól és azzal összefüggő egyéb törvények módosításáról". Record text is the as-published instrument cut from Magyar Közlöny 2023. évi 187. szám (2026-11-02 fetch, pdftotext). Hungarian is the only official language; no government English was found (see ### Languages in SOURCES.md). The act has been amended many times (NJT version list read 2026-11-02: 14 entries, the version in force from 2026-01-01 is marked current); only the as-published text is stored because the consolidated versions sit under row HU-NJT-CONSOLIDATED (permission requested). The 2024-01-01 record therefore is not the text in force today.

title: Act C of 2000 on Accounting (2000. évi C. törvény a számvitelről), Chapter III/A sustainability report (ss. 95/D to 95/I) and Chapter VI/C consolidated sustainability report
citation: 2000. évi C. törvény, Chapters III/A and VI/C inserted by 2023. évi CVIII. törvény ss. 61 and 63
evidence: NJT footnote 584 on Chapter III/A: "A III/A. Fejezetet (95/D-95/I. §-t) a 2023. évi CVIII. törvény 61. §-a iktatta be." and 2023. évi CVIII. törvény 53. § (1): "Ez a törvény – a (2)–(5) bekezdésben meghatározott kivétellel – 2024. január 1-jén lép hatályba." (ss. 61 and 63 are not among the exceptions in (2)-(5)). Opened https://njt.jog.gov.hu/jogszabaly/2000-100-00-00 and the Magyar Közlöny 2023. évi 187. szám PDF on 2026-11-02.
notes: Link only: the sustainability chapters exist only inside the consolidated Accounting Act (a 1.3 MB page with its own időállapot versions), which is on row HU-NJT-CONSOLIDATED (permission requested). status_note: Only the consolidated text carries the chapters; row HU-NJT-CONSOLIDATED is permission requested.
